rows.description: Zero raw `readFileSync` or `writeFileSync` calls exist in `SpecValidator.ts` and `IntentVerifier.ts` — all file operations use `StateManager.read()` and `StateManager.write()` with atomic write guarantees
rows.verifyMethod: `grep -rn "readFileSync|writeFileSync" src/SpecValidator.ts src/IntentVerifier.ts` returns 0 results; CI static analysis gate blocks merge if found

rows.description: `IntentVerifier.ts` successfully imports inference logic from `src/inference/index.ts` and the LLM-as-judge pathway executes end-to-end without import errors or runtime failures
rows.verifyMethod: `tsc --noEmit` passes with zero errors; `IntentVerifier.verify()` unit test with `requiresLLMJudge=true` passes; mocked LLM response returns valid `ValidationResult`

rows.description: `loop.sh` does NOT contain `--dangerously-skip-permissions` in any default argument, variable assignment, or non-flag-gated code path — permission checks are enforced by default
rows.verifyMethod: `grep -n "dangerously-skip-permissions" loop.sh` returns 0 results in default paths; only appears inside `if [ "$RALPHLOOP_TRUST_MODE" = "1" ]` guard; `shellcheck loop.sh` passes clean

rows.description: Test coverage on statistical calculation code is ≥80% with explicit edge case tests for empty arrays, NaN, Infinity, single-element arrays, and negative values
rows.verifyMethod: Jest coverage report shows ≥80% line + branch coverage on statistical code files; `__tests__/statistical.test.ts` contains ≥10 test cases covering each named edge case

rows.description: Test coverage on LLM-as-judge pathway code is ≥80% with mock fixtures for 5+ response scenarios: valid approval, valid rejection, malformed response, timeout, and empty/null response
rows.verifyMethod: Jest coverage report shows ≥80% on `src/inference/` files; `__tests__/fixtures/llm-responses/` contains ≥5 fixture files; `__tests__/llm-judge.test.ts` tests each scenario

rows.description: Test coverage on all modified files (`SpecValidator.ts`, `IntentVerifier.ts`, `src/inference/*`) is ≥90% — no modified code ships without proportional test coverage
rows.verifyMethod: Jest `--coverageThreshold` configured per-file; CI blocks merge if any modified file falls below 90% line coverage

rows.description: When the LLM-judge is unavailable (network error, timeout, API failure), `IntentVerifier` gracefully degrades to rule-based validation via `fallback.ts`, logs a warning with diagnostic info, and returns a valid `ValidationResult`
rows.verifyMethod: Unit test mocks inference module to throw/timeout; verify fallback activates, warning logged, `ValidationResult` returned with `method: 'rule-based'` field

rows.description: Zero `fetch()` calls exist outside of `CachedHTTPClient` usage anywhere in the _RALPHLOOP codebase — all HTTP operations go through the cached client
rows.verifyMethod: `grep -rn "fetch(" src/` returns 0 results outside `CachedHTTPClient` wrapper calls; CI static analysis gate enforces

rows.description: `MIGRATION.md` exists and contains ≥1 before/after code example for every breaking change, a rollback procedure, and step-by-step upgrade instructions for downstream consumers
rows.verifyMethod: Manual PR review checklist; file exists at project root; contains sections: "Breaking Changes", "Migration Steps", "Before/After Examples", "Rollback Procedure"

rows.description: `BREAKING_CHANGES.md` exhaustively lists every changed public API surface with severity classification (critical/major/minor), affected consumers, and recommended migration action
rows.verifyMethod: Manual PR review checklist; every changed export/function signature is documented; cross-referenced against `git diff` of public exports

rows.description: Backward compatibility wrappers exist for all changed public APIs — wrappers delegate to new implementations, log deprecation warnings pointing to `MIGRATION.md`, and are scheduled for removal after 2-week deprecation window
rows.verifyMethod: Unit tests verify deprecated wrappers call new implementations and produce console warnings matching pattern `DEPRECATED:.*see MIGRATION.md`; wrappers have `@deprecated` JSDoc tags

rows.description: `StateManager.write()` operations are atomic — no partial file state is possible even on process interruption; schema validation occurs on `StateManager.read()` to reject corrupted data
rows.verifyMethod: Unit test simulates write interruption (mock `StateManager.write()` to throw mid-operation); verify file retains previous valid state; unit test feeds malformed JSON to `StateManager.read()` and verifies rejection with diagnostic error

rows.description: All git operations during the refactor occur on a single `refactor/ralphloop-hardening` branch with atomic commit scripts that assert current branch before every operation — preventing the cross-contamination pattern documented in project memory
rows.verifyMethod: Commit wrapper script contains `[[ "$(git branch --show-current)" == "refactor/ralphloop-hardening" ]] || exit 1`; no parallel feature branches created for this work

rows.description: The full test suite (excluding `@integration` tagged tests) executes in <30 seconds; `@integration` tests execute in <30 seconds per test case and are excluded from the default `npm test` command
